bug.title: No test guards the /verify manifest loop fix (1678779) or API request rates on production builds
bug.symptoms: 1678779 changed only use-file-check.ts and verify-page.tsx; npm run test:e2e still runs 31 tests and none opens /verify with an id The loop came from the production minifier inlining a module-level loader into a default parameter, which unit tests on source cannot see; only a production-build browser test catches it
bug.reproduction_steps: git show --stat 1678779; npm run test:e2e (31 tests, no /verify?id case)
bug.expected: A unit test renders useFileCheck/VerifyPage with an id and a loader that is a new function on every render (e.g. an inline arrow in a re-rendering parent), re-renders several times, and asserts the loader ran once, and once more after retry; a Playwright test (production build, as the suite already runs) opens /verify?id={seeded version}/v1, counts manifest requests over 2 s after load (at most 1), drops the version's main.pdf and sees the match verdict, then drops an unrelated file and sees the mismatch verdict; the same Playwright file visits /, a paper page and its Reviews/Discussion/Proof tabs, /verify, /network, /search?q=reward and /c/cs.AI, and asserts no API path is requested more than 5 times within 3 s of load; the Playwright test fails against a build with the loop reintroduced (check by temporarily reverting 1678779 locally, not in the commit)

constraints.constraint: Test-only: do not change application code unless a new test exposes a defect
